item: implement the candy per-floor daily cap in CODE (a02 falsifier: doc-only)
note: SEASONAL_LAUNCH.md FALSIFIERS (lines 131-132) registered 'cap candy per floor per day if needed' but named no number. Derived cap = 6 candy per floor per day from the code's own spawn math: each floor emits exactly 6 static CandyBones at build, so a full daily sweep always pays and only overflow (the King's 40-candy shower) is muted; King's 500 VM award untouched; max print 12 VM/floor/day (36/day, 72 with doubler) vs 50-3000 VM sinks. Implemented in the same economy path: gate in dropCandy Touched before the +2*mult VM write. Capped candy pays nothing that day and stays in the world (no pay-nothing pickups). Per-player UTC-day tallies in Player attributes (same store as CandyDoublerUntil). Spec-first: derivation recorded in SEASONAL_LAUNCH.md falsifier AND beside the constant. Em-dash law: 0 em-dashes in added text (pre-existing ones left in place, cited in t2.check.txt CHECK 9). mountain_check NOT run (held by t1a this wave).
